# Nomad Spin

> Spin a 3D globe and discover your next digital nomad destination. Compare 780+ cities on cost of living, internet speed, safety, and visa rules.

Nomad Spin matches destinations to your preferences (budget, internet, safety, proximity, landscape, vibe), then helps you book stays, flights, eSIMs, and insurance via curated partner links.

## Core pages

- [Home / Spin](/): Interactive globe and preference matching across 780+ cities.
- [Destinations](/destinations/): City pages with cost, internet, safety, visa notes, and related guides.
- [Guides](/guides): In-depth guides, tax residency, and remote-work strategy.
- [About](/about): How Nomad Spin works.
- [Contact](/contact): Feedback, city suggestions, questions.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy) | [Terms of Use](/terms-of-use)
